title: AI Templates: Gabriela and Aishwarya
talk_summary: A Microsoft workshop demoing open-source 'AI templates' (chat quickstart, RAG-on-Postgres, RAG-on-documents) deployed via GitHub Codespaces and azd/Bicep, aimed at getting startups to a running app in minutes. Most content is Azure/Founders Hub marketing and live setup troubleshooting; the only transferable substance is a few RAG design and evaluation practices.

takeaways.technique: Hybrid retrieval (vector + full-text) with semantic reranking, not vector-only
takeaways.what_they_do: Run both vector search and keyword/full-text search over the same corpus, fuse results, and apply a semantic ranker against the original query; they warn vector-only always returns 'similar' but noisy results that distract the LLM.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you use Vector search alone you will not get good results ... you need to have a hybrid search
takeaways.numbers: text-only groundedness 4.87; only ~0.02 improvement from adding vectors without semantic ranker

takeaways.what_they_do: A first LLM call rewrites the user question into a search-optimized query (and can emit structured filters via function calling) before hitting the index.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we take the user's question and we rewrite it into a better query because user questions aren't really optimized for searching

takeaways.technique: Evaluate retrieval configs with groundedness scores instead of assuming vectors help
takeaways.what_they_do: They ran measured comparisons of text-only vs text+vector vs hybrid+semantic-ranker and reported groundedness numbers, warning against blindly adopting vector search.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the thing you should do is evaluate ... I only was able to get 02 Improvement by moving to Text Plus Vector

takeaways.technique: Reproducible containerized dev environments (Codespaces) to kill 'works on my machine'
takeaways.what_they_do: Every template opens in a preconfigured container so all participants share an identical environment; they also flag cost/cleanup of idle environments.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you use code spaces you don't have that problem because I will have the same environment
takeaways.numbers: 60 free Codespace hours/month; idle auto-shutdown configurable

takeaways.technique: Stream responses / time-to-first-token for perceived speed
takeaways.what_they_do: Use async frameworks and stream tokens to the client so output appears immediately rather than after full generation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: as soon as you get that first token you can start streaming in that first token
